card.text: Explore Mars in 3D with cssEarth. Discover the red planet’s volcanoes, deep canyons, polar ice, and thin atmosphere in an interactive explorer.

introduction.text: Mars is a cold, dusty desert world with a thin atmosphere, polar ice caps, extinct volcanoes, deep canyons, seasons, and weather.

normal.title: MDIM 2.1 colorized global mosaic
normal.summary: Surface detail comes from Viking images with NASA Ames color. Lighting and resolution vary; these are archival observations.

elevation.title: MOLA global color shaded relief
elevation.summary: Colors describe terrain height and shading reveals slopes. This published relief image does not provide a numeric readout.

thermal.title: THEMIS daytime infrared mosaic
thermal.summary: Brightness records daytime infrared intensity from combined observations. Black bands at the map edges are missing source coverage, not measurements.
